customers.evidence: From day one, we've provided people with tools to help them move forward and upward.

environment.evidence: Ford has made measurable gains against ambitious environmental sustainability targets.

community.evidence: To help build a better world, where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams.

integrity.evidence: we've worked to earn their trust, every single day

innovation.evidence: We've innovated to expand their opportunities.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice centers a universal purpose of freedom of movement and a better world. Commitments are stated absolutely ('We are here for one purpose'), with customers addressed through tools and opportunity. Environment appears only as a report-blurb mention. Employees, shareholders and safety are absent.
